purpose: Compare the stride-24 AutoCon candidate with the local plain MambaTS baseline inspired by the official MambaTS public architecture.
research_question: Does the stride-24 relation-auxiliary MambaTSv3 candidate retain an advantage over a plain MambaTS patch/variable-scan baseline across low- and high-dimensional H96 datasets?
architecture_boundary: MambaTS is a local reproducible implementation of public patch-token and variable-aware scan ideas, not a bitwise reproduction of the official VAST/VPT code. The candidate adds only the local v3 shared-context/persistence path and train-time AutoCon relation objective; prediction fusion is disabled.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or held-out release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: This matrix can compare the registered local architectures on validation data only. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, a causal AutoCon effect, official MambaTS reproduction, universal speed, or universal generalization.

required_before_launch: verify four dataset fingerprints and exact 24-job expansion
freeze candidate, MambaTS baseline, optimizer, normalization, and seed contracts

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Architecture, AutoCon coefficient, patching, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, datasets, and seeds are fixed before launch. No held-out signal or dataset-specific retuning is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Both arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, patch geometry, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: MambaTSv3AutoCon uses v3 shared context/persistence and AutoCon lambda=.001. Prediction-connected fusion, ACF memory, and every optional candidate route are disabled.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: MambaTS uses the v1 patch/variable-scan backbone with AutoCon, representation fusion, ACF memory, and candidate-only routes disabled.

phases.name: stride24_plain_mambats_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Plain local MambaTS v1 patch/variable-scan baseline.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report every paired cell. Fixed-shape GPU resources are measured separately and may not be substituted for training throughput.

stopping_rules: Keep ETTh1 as a mandatory failure-boundary cell even if high-dimensional datasets pass.
Do not claim a causal AutoCon benefit from this architecture comparison.
Do not promote any result to a held-out release or run a test loader.
